mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_task_output_plans WHERE tenant_id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint) AND run_id=#{run} AND goal_completion_state='pending')
SELECT status,reason FROM nw_task_results WHERE tenant_id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint) AND run_id=#{run}
SELECT revision_id FROM nw_task_result_deliverables WHERE tenant_id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint) AND run_id=#{run} ORDER BY ordinal

SELECT p.run_id FROM nw_task_output_plans p JOIN agent_runtime_execution_runs r ON r.tenant_id=p.tenant_id::text AND r.run_id=p.run_id WHERE p.tenant_id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint) AND r.phase='FINISHED' AND (p.state IN ('planned','finalizing') OR p.goal_completion_state='pending') ORDER BY CASE WHEN p.goal_completion_state='pending' AND p.state IN ('finalized','abandoned') THEN 0 WHEN p.goal_completion_state='pending' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,p.updated_at,p.run_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_task_output_plans SET state='finalizing',frozen=CAST(#{frozen} AS jsonb),frozen_hash=#{hash}, goal_completion_state=#{completionState},updated_at=now() WHERE tenant_id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint) AND run_id=#{run} AND state='planned'
UPDATE nw_task_output_plans SET goal_completion_state=#{state},updated_at=now() WHERE tenant_id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint) AND run_id=#{run} AND goal_completion_state='pending'
mapper.delete:
DELETE FROM nw_deliverable_file_holds h WHERE h.tenant_id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint) AND h.run_id=#{run} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_task_output_plans p WHERE p.tenant_id=h.tenant_id AND p.run_id=h.run_id AND p.state IN ('finalized','abandoned'))
AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_task_output_plans p WHERE p.tenant_id=h.tenant_id AND p.run_id=h.run_id AND p.goal_completion_state='pending')
mapper.select: SELECT d.logical_key AS key,r.title,r.kind,r.id AS base_revision_id,p.plan::text AS plan FROM nw_deliverables d JOIN nw_deliverable_revisions r ON r.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND r.id=d.current_revision_id JOIN nw_task_output_plans p ON p.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND p.run_id=r.run_id WHERE d.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND d.session_id=#{session} ORDER BY d.logical_key
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_task_output_plans(tenant_id,run_id,session_id,owner_session_id,run_identity,state,plan) VALUES(#{tenant},#{runId},#{session},#{sessionId},#{runIdentity}::jsonb,'planned',#{payload}::jsonb) ON CONFLICT(tenant_id,run_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_task_output_plans SET state='abandoned',abandonment_reason=#{abandonReason},updated_at=now() WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND run_id=#{runId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_deliverables(tenant_id,id,session_id,logical_key) VALUES(#{tenant},#{id},#{session},#{key}) ON CONFLICT(tenant_id,session_id,logical_key) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id, id, session_id, logical_key, current_revision_id, reserved_run_id, created_at FROM nw_deliverables WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND session_id=#{session} AND logical_key=#{key} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_deliverables SET reserved_run_id=#{runId} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id, id, artifact_id, path, size, sha256, expires_at, status FROM nw_execution_artifact_files WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{fileId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT tenant_id, id, artifact_id, path, size, sha256, expires_at, status FROM nw_execution_artifact_files WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND artifact_id=#{artifactId} AND path=#{path} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_deliverable_file_holds(tenant_id,run_id,file_id) VALUES(#{tenant},#{runId},#{fileId}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO nw_task_results(tenant_id,run_id,session_id,status,reason) VALUES(#{tenant},#{runId},#{sessionId},#{state},#{reason}) ON CONFLICT(tenant_id,run_id) DO UPDATE SET status=excluded.status,reason=excluded.reason
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_task_output_plans SET state='abandoned',updated_at=now() WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND run_id=#{runId}
UPDATE nw_task_results SET status='failed',reason='publication_validation_failed' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND run_id=#{runId}
UPDATE nw_task_output_plans SET state='abandoned',abandonment_reason='publication_validation_failed',updated_at=now() WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND run_id=#{runId}
mapper.select: SELECT current_revision_id,reserved_run_id FROM nw_deliverables WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{deliverableId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT tenant_id, id, session_id, logical_key, current_revision_id, reserved_run_id, created_at FROM nw_deliverables WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{deliverableId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT tenant_id, id, deliverable_id, revision_no, run_id, previous_revision_id, title, kind, fingerprint, change_type, created_at FROM nw_deliverable_revisions WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{baseRevisionId}
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_deliverables SET current_revision_id=#{revision} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{deliverableId}
UPDATE nw_task_results SET status='published',published_at=now() WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND run_id=#{runId}
UPDATE nw_task_output_plans SET state='finalized',updated_at=now() WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND run_id=#{runId}
mapper.select: SELECT d.logical_key AS key,r.title,r.kind,r.id AS base_revision_id,r.revision_no, rp.role,rp.format,rp.primary_preview,rp.entry_path,rf.file_id,f.artifact_id,f.path,f.sha256, CASE WHEN fmt->>'decision_source' IN ('user_explicit','previous_explicit') THEN 'previous_explicit' ELSE fmt->>'decision_source' END AS decision_source, (fmt->>'required')::boolean AS required FROM nw_deliverables d JOIN nw_deliverable_revisions r ON r.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND r.id=d.current_revision_id JOIN nw_deliverable_representations rp ON rp.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND rp.revision_id=r.id JOIN nw_task_output_plans p ON p.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND p.run_id=r.run_id JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(p.plan->'deliverables') item ON item->>'key'=d.logical_key JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(item->'formats') fmt ON fmt->>'format'=rp.format JOIN nw_deliverable_representation_files rf ON rf.tenant_id=rp.tenant_id AND rf.representation_id=rp.id JOIN nw_execution_artifact_files f ON f.tenant_id=rf.tenant_id AND f.id=rf.file_id WHERE d.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND d.session_id=#{sessionId} ORDER BY d.logical_key,rp.format,rf.ordinal
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_task_results SET status='failed',reason=#{reason} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND run_id=#{runId}
UPDATE nw_task_output_plans SET state='abandoned',abandonment_reason=#{reason},updated_at=now() WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND run_id=#{runId}
UPDATE nw_deliverables SET reserved_run_id=null WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND reserved_run_id=#{runId}
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id, run_id, session_id, owner_session_id, run_identity, state, frozen_hash, abandonment_reason, goal_completion_state, created_at, updated_at,plan::text AS plan,frozen::text AS frozen FROM nw_task_output_plans WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND run_id=#{runId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, r.deliverable_id, r.revision_no, r.run_id, r.previous_revision_id, r.title, r.kind, r.fingerprint, r.change_type, r.created_at,d.current_revision_id FROM nw_deliverable_revisions r JOIN nw_deliverables d ON d.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND d.id=r.deliverable_id WHERE d.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND d.session_id=#{session} ORDER BY r.created_at,r.id

SELECT rp.revision_id,rp.id AS representation_id,rp.format,rp.primary_preview,rp.entry_path, rf.relative_path,rf.download_name,f.tenant_id, f.id, f.artifact_id, f.path, f.size, f.sha256, f.expires_at, f.status FROM nw_deliverable_representation_files rf JOIN nw_execution_artifact_files f ON f.tenant_id=rf.tenant_id AND f.id=rf.file_id JOIN nw_deliverable_representations rp ON rp.tenant_id=rf.tenant_id AND rp.id=rf.representation_id JOIN nw_deliverable_revisions r ON r.tenant_id=rp.tenant_id AND r.id=rp.revision_id JOIN nw_deliverables d ON d.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND d.id=r.deliverable_id WHERE d.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND d.session_id=#{session} ORDER BY r.id,rp.primary_preview DESC,rp.id,rf.ordinal

SELECT rd.revision_id,rd.run_id FROM nw_task_result_deliverables rd JOIN nw_task_results t ON t.tenant_id=rd.tenant_id AND t.run_id=rd.run_id WHERE t.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND t.session_id=#{session} AND t.status='published' ORDER BY t.published_at

SELECT e.run_id,e.summary,f.artifact_id,f.path FROM nw_task_evidence e JOIN nw_execution_artifact_files f ON f.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND f.id=e.file_id JOIN nw_task_results t ON t.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND t.run_id=e.run_id WHERE t.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND t.session_id=#{session} AND t.status='published' AND e.expires_at>now()
SELECT d.session_id FROM nw_deliverable_revisions r JOIN nw_deliverables d ON d.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND d.id=r.deliverable_id WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND r.id=#{revision}

SELECT f.tenant_id, f.id, f.artifact_id, f.path, f.size, f.sha256, f.expires_at, f.status,rf.download_name,rf.relative_path,rp.format,rp.entry_path,rp.id AS representation_id, d.session_id,r.title,r.revision_no,d.current_revision_id FROM nw_deliverable_representation_files rf JOIN nw_execution_artifact_files f ON f.tenant_id=rf.tenant_id AND f.id=rf.file_id JOIN nw_deliverable_representations rp ON rp.tenant_id=rf.tenant_id AND rp.id=rf.representation_id JOIN nw_deliverable_revisions r ON r.tenant_id=rp.tenant_id AND r.id=rp.revision_id JOIN nw_deliverables d ON d.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND d.id=r.deliverable_id WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND r.id=#{revision} AND f.id=#{fileId}
SELECT file_id FROM nw_deliverable_representation_files WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND representation_id=#{representation} AND relative_path=#{relativePath}
SELECT count(*) FROM nw_deliverable_representation_files WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND representation_id=#{representation}
